description: A React component for displaying and managing a card dialog in a board application, including features like editing, deleting, attaching files, and creating templates.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the properties accepted by the CardDialog component.

methods.name: makeTemplateClicked
methods.description: Handles creating a new template from the current card, tracking telemetry, and duplicating the card.

methods.name: handleDeleteCard
methods.description: Handles deleting the current card, including telemetry tracking.

methods.name: confirmDialogProps
methods.description: Configuration object for the confirmation dialog box shown before deleting a card.

methods.name: handleDeleteButtonOnClick
methods.description: Handles the delete button click, confirming if the card should be deleted.

methods.name: removeUploadingAttachment
methods.description: Removes an attachment block that is in uploading state.

methods.name: selectAttachment
methods.description: Opens file selector, uploads the attachment, and resolves with the attachment block.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new attachment element to the card.

methods.name: deleteBlock
methods.description: Deletes a specified block (attachment) from the card.

methods.name: attachBtn
methods.description: Renders the attach button with permission gating.
